behavior: Interactive connect chooses Resume/Add/Cancel before vault access, discovery or replacement.
Adding uses a new operator-reviewed remote setup root and generated binding alias; no previous identity credential is reused for the additional collaborator.
Pending drafts and handoffs recover the retained root/checkpoints. Explicit request IDs and legacy scripts remain supported.
Previous workspace reference is only a review hint, never project or filesystem authority.
Generated operator-side connection shortcut removes the need to invent CONNECT_PROFILE; operator authentication remains explicit.
Existing daemon, Core protocol, canonical identity/import/registration/realization/recovery and grants remain reused.

tests.cut: Final picker negatives after retained-record and host-label hardening
Picker/import pipeline and two real synthetic registration/realization recovery cases

limitations: Fixture transports and temporary file vaults are not a real remote host or provider.
No native harness, login-session event, paid campaign or personal installation was exercised.
Full UI/CLI/Connector journey remains a separate Nexus UI-R1 gate.
rollback: Revert picker integration without deleting retained setup roots, bindings, credentials or daemon state. Explicit legacy request/receipt flows remain compatible.
